abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 155 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 197 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 151 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 156 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 166 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 151 | 300 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
